coordinate_convention: Image origin top-left; y downward. Vertical ruler marked millimeters. Annotated long graduation lines, not text baselines.
sensitivity_meaning: A deliberately coarse +/-6 px annotation perturbation for sensitivity analysis, not a measured confidence interval or camera calibration accuracy.
method: Least-squares y=a*millimeters+b on training ruler marks, report held-out residuals. Divide shaft-center vertical pixel separation by a. No homography or 3D pose estimate.
